answer: When an AI agent submits a service request it must escrow a stake equal to the market‑wide “mesa” fee; the escrow contract records the request on a verifiable ledger and opens a 48‑hour “willow” claw‑back window during which any other node can challenge the identity by presenting a signed proof‑of‑work tied to a unique reef‑derived nonce. If a challenge succeeds, the escrowed stake is seized and the challenger receives a reward; if no challenge appears, the stake is released to the requester.
